name: gVisor 20261102.0
body:
## gVisor release 20261102.0

Binaries are also available from the apt repository and the release bucket;
see [Installation](https://gvisor.dev/docs/user_guide/install/).

### Changes since `release-20261026.0`

```text
proc: generate /proc/cpuinfo on read (7a675ac66)
proc, sys, kernfs: lazily populate /proc/sys and /sys/devices/system/cpu (8a719e832)
kernfs, proc, sys: Evict cached dentries in PrepareSave (918aefd5f)
Start the gofer with GOMAXPROCS bounded by its cgroup and capped at 8. (0cf7325e4)
pkg/state, runsc: switch default state engine to graph (6e6276344)
runsc/cmd, pkg/state: harden statefile output, HTML, and HMAC checks (85dbf4e65)
pkg/state: fix graph engine round-trip and pooled scratch bugs (0bbcbf9de)
Avoid holding shim locks across container creation and cache nil PodExtension. (7b2516a55)
Check SampledTimer EventRegister errors, and fix a stale comment (4f5ce20bd)
Don't let CLOCK_MONOTONIC go backwards when a restored kernel resumes (14313213c)
runsc/container: add active workload and cross-engine checkpoint E2E tests (3fb68e32c)
buildkite coordinator: fetch maintainers from governance/maintainers.yaml (dfeb3ce48)
buildkite: skip unnecessary clones (2116e5da2)
Rewrite vdsoClockGettime (085e111d7)
runsc: add --state-engine flag and per-checkpoint override (fc74469da)
Add runsc do and sandboxexec benchmarks. (558e98d97)

governance: add maintainers' GitHub user IDs (8f15deb0c)
pkg/state/tests: run existing and callback tests with both engines (1398e3d66)

pkg/state: add deferred decoding and PrintGraph unit tests (d12b0a39b)

Calibrate the clocks during restore, so the VDSO works on resume (eeb83261a)

Measure relative CLOCK_REALTIME sleeps and timers with CLOCK_MONOTONIC (d87a01824)
Build the Bun spawn image with Bazel (a693e2364)
pkg/state: add round-trip tests for array aliasing and aliased maps (f8de95433)
tools/go_stateify: emit typed calls, registration, and callbacks (20/21) (cd90d7a74)
Add raw sandbox boot benchmarks. (a37bafc5d)
pkg/state: add typed Sink/Source methods and dual-engine dispatch (19/21) (aa5305e99)
Add seccomp-bpf filter rules for netgofer. (757d67e79)
pkg/state: add graph stream pretty-printer and typeInfo tests (18/21) (fbef70ac6)
pkg/state: add deferred object decoding and callback scheduler (17/21) (85d46891e)
pkg/state: add value and composite decoding to graph decoder (16/21) (3dd75fc57)
pkg/state: add graph decoder state and object/target table readers (15/21) (d8ff47859)
buildkite: rename the untrusted cluster's queue to `untrusted` (a7203afca)
pkg/state: add stream assembly to graph encoder (14/21) (6fb2e9fe2)
rdmaproxy: reject unsupported QP creation modes (98dae51e6)
gofer: restore the read-locked fast path in ensureSharedHandle (97d1256de)
pkg/state: add value, map, struct, and splice encoding to graph encoder (13/21) (8f9e31edd)
kernel: index unimplemented-syscall metric field values by a slice (ac2fe8a8e)
Keep FUSE device watches attached after connection abort (1e5a147a4)
pkg/state: add pointer and slice target resolution to graph encoder (12/21) (f4b41f15b)
pkg/state: add graph encoder state and object slabs (11/21) (9010b868a)
pkg/state: add per-stream type caches, type table, and graph stats (10/21) (0fa6803f2)
pkg/state: add reflection-free runtime typeInfo (9/21) (03e72471a)
Link host-run benchmarks and the container test app statically (b9193eed0)
pkg/state: add encoding buffers and open-addressed address map (8/21) (f8cc8437f)
pkg/tcpip/network/ipv4: remove unused IP ID generation state (7/21) (ac7b4e0fd)
Automated rollback of changelist 1009271256 (f4c82a02f)
pkg/cpuid: save static CPUID function as packed bytes (6/21) (bcd924122)
nvproxy: Mark NVIDIA driver 580.95.05 as supported again (8ab9b43b6)
runsc: don't sample sentry heap allocations unless --profile is set (5f1b5b271)
Update rules_python to 2.4.5 (32bf29155)
Require a usable TCP timestamp echo for Eifel detection (450dd7775)
docs: add the gVisor channels on CNCF Slack (730cdb7e2)
runsc: don't sample gofer heap allocations unless --profile is set (862346bab)
tcpip/stack: don't presize neighbor caches for NeighborCacheSize entries (5683e4b9a)
Mark myself as being on hiatus. (1b7482678)

Pass host inode numbers through the gofer client (8ead67b1c)
seccheck: validate point fields without allocating (54a7bf0f0)
Check locking of the pipe splice cursor (7022c2361)
pkg/sentry/vfs: allocate FileLocks lock sets on first use (5/21) (509ad5337)
test/benchmarks/checkpointfile: add statefile and GC benchmarks (4/21) (a9c4e2084)
pkg/state/tests: add randomized graph tests and benchmarks (3/21) (d939ff3ab)

pkg/state/tests: add random object graph generator (2/21) (79c6a439f)
Internal change. (d42bae25a)

pkg/state/tests: add graph isomorphism checker (1/21) (ec8390e5f)

Move coretag cookie creation to prewarmer stage. (867d93e6a)

seccheck: add a benchmark for Initialize (fd0e19367)

Release the startup heap to the host once the sandbox is idle (6bb4d1893)
Add Kernel.WaitForIdle (258207547)

seccheck: make TestPointRegistrationFields test field validation (2896af932)
Use rules_qemu for cross-architecture generators (61088c907)
nvproxy: hugepage-align application memory mirrors (d05ab617a)
Check inotify locking contracts (f64a22fd6)
Declare the copy tool for architecture outputs (42a8333d1)
runsc/bwrap: Support --dev in bwrap personality (7f10cf978)
Roll back failed epoll registrations (9f6054c77)
Select Linux UAPI headers independently (b8420d7dc)
Check locking of file epoll registrations (eec6ed445)
pgalloc: skip decommitting zero pages when a checkpoint does not resume (418a5d441)
benchmarks: wait for an HTTP response from restored Nginx (5fc68d2b9)
Remove the unused basic Ruby image (c7cd9df3d)
Pin Alpine for the empty-container benchmarks (0a730fd58)
pgalloc: recycle hugepage-aligned ranges for huge allocations (25209dc53)
`runsc` state: Reload gofer fields, don't leak loaded state file on error (a6070d26b)
Compare UDP checksums as transmitted on the wire (beb37f745)
cuda-tests: Don't report timed-out samples as passing. (05e46bd5b)
seccheck: build trace point descriptions only when needed (43d42197e)
netlink: send a 4-byte payload in NLMSG_DONE (d2c63e2e1)
buildkite coordinator: expect to run on a VM instead of Cloud Run (acae2e0d5)
buildkite: stop setting BAZEL_REMOTE_CACHE in pre-command (8dbabb771)
tmpfs: let huge page fills recycle waste pages (540cd026e)
Restore basic image sources in the shared context archive (dc6c326b8)
runsc/bwrap: Support --as-pid-1 in bwrap personality (bcc22e169)
document sandboxes without a root container (11d4d7042)
Internal change. (dc0734572)
Build the syscall benchmark image with Bazel (67adaaa43)
Honor `--sandbox-creation-cpu-policy` until first non-root container (81e811f89)
Reject invalid IDs during user resolution (18ba8a82e)
Clear the parent-death signal under the task mutex (ff770a721)
state: benchmark late array parent discovery (d8c5f75da)
Preserve SACK on connections accepted with SYN cookies (0b06fce45)
Initialize CUBIC congestion-avoidance epochs (0ef892cc5)
buildkite: add first-pass.yaml (adf99ead2)
fix a sentry panic when containers share a no-root sandbox's PID namespace (ccc363493)
buildkite coordinator: remove stacktest=yes filter (962ecf27b)
Preserve procfs lookup errors during creation (b039155d0)
Reject unrepresentable TPU operation timeouts (72b4500d3)
`runsc create`: Boot the sandbox asynchronously. (947e20e7f)
Avoid relocking the signal mutex on a platform error (94cbcd44b)
Read the group exit status under the signal mutex (7a75a6400)
Allocate advisory file lock trees on first use (710b3f2e9)
Reuse BPF execution metrics in seccomp (61b42ce8e)
state: centralize wire payload loading (3c6804639)
Restore the RACK reordering test (792659c37)
Refactor gofer related packages. (d79912977)
pgalloc: reject inconsistent async page saves (29b76eaf1)
Wait for veth operational state in the netlink test (1be507cab)
runsc/bwrap: Support --dir in bwrap personality (7d6ec0b3d)
Share the Docker Hub mirror order across test images (248c3a910)
runsc: allow Process.OOMScoreAdj to change across checkpoint/restore (5dcc62069)
gofer: do not stat cached regular files during PrepareSave by default (fced9335d)
`runsc`: Perform state file modifications atomically. (94fc2579d)
Size readers in checkpoint/restore per sandbox lifecycle CPU limit (3298a461e)
Build the filesystem stress test on the official BusyBox image (97c071a74)
Default runsc restore to --background and --direct-io=auto (d0f7ca889)
overlay: Skip copy-up for chown that does not change the owner (06ea590f4)
Restrict /proc/gvisor/spec_environ to the container's user (d9d108d2e)
Load xtables matches before testing INET rules (f13051312)
```
